question: True or false: using ? : instead of if creates different <li> "instances" that keep separate state.
say: True or false: using the ternary instead of if creates different list item instances that keep separate state.
explanation: False. JSX elements hold no state and are not DOM nodes. They are blueprints, so both versions are equivalent.
explainSay: False. JSX elements are just blueprints with no state, so both versions are the same.
